<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;700;300;500;600&family=Syne:wght@400;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--my-project-s-bg:#0a0a12;--my-project-s-accent:#c8ff00;--my-project-s-text:#f5f3ee;--my-project-s-surface:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);--my-project-s-border:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);--my-project-s-fd:'Syne',sans-serif;--my-project-s-fb:'DM Sans',sans-serif;--my-project-s-fm:'Space Mono',monospace;}
body,.elementor-page,#page,.site{background:#0a0a12!important;color:#f5f3ee;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;}

.elementor-section,.e-con,.elementor-container{position:relative;z-index:2;}

.my-project-s-reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);}
html.my-project-s-motion-ready .my-project-s-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);}
html.my-project-s-motion-ready .my-project-s-reveal.my-project-s-visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.my-project-s-d1{transition-delay:.1s;}.my-project-s-d2{transition-delay:.2s;}.my-project-s-d3{transition-delay:.3s;}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px;}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#0a0a12;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,255,0,.3);}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#c8ff00;}
.elementor-editor-active .my-project-s-reveal, .elementor-editor-active [class*='reveal'], .elementor-editor-active [class*='hidden'] { opacity: 1 !important; visibility: visible !important; transform: none !important; transition: none !important; }
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)} 50%{opacity:0.5;transform:scale(1.4)} }
</style>
<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
document.documentElement.classList.add('my-project-s-motion-ready');
if(document.body){document.body.classList.add('my-project-s-page');}
else{document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){if(document.body){document.body.classList.add('my-project-s-page');}});}





/* ── Scroll Reveal ── */
var sObs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
  entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(e.isIntersecting || window.elementor) e.target.classList.add('my-project-s-visible');
  });
},{threshold:.1});

function initR(){
  var revs=document.querySelectorAll('.my-project-s-reveal');
  revs.forEach(function(el){
    // Safe reveal: if element is already in viewport or we are in Elementor editor
    var rect=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if((rect.top<window.innerHeight&&rect.bottom>0)||window.elementor){
      el.classList.add('my-project-s-visible');
    }
    sObs.observe(el);
  });
  // Fail-safe: show everything if JS fails or taking too long
  setTimeout(function(){document.querySelectorAll('.my-project-s-reveal:not(.my-project-s-visible)').forEach(function(f){f.classList.add('my-project-s-visible');});},2500);
}
if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initR);}else{initR();}

function initStatCounters(){
  var statCards=document.querySelectorAll('.my-project-s-stat-cell');
  if(!statCards.length || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)){return;}
  var seen=new WeakSet();
  var parseValue=function(text){
    var raw=(text||'').trim();
    var match=raw.match(/^([\d.,]+)(.*)$/);
    if(!match){return null;}
    var num=parseFloat(match[1].replace(/,/g,''));
    if(isNaN(num)){return null;}
    var decimals=(match[1].split('.')[1]||'').length;
    return { value:num, decimals:decimals, suffix:(match[2]||'').trim() };
  };
  var obs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(!entry.isIntersecting || seen.has(entry.target)){return;}
      seen.add(entry.target);
      entry.target.classList.add('my-project-s-counted');
      var heading=entry.target.querySelector('.my-project-s-stat-num .elementor-heading-title');
      if(!heading){return;}
      var parsed=parseValue(heading.textContent);
      if(!parsed){return;}
      var cur=0, steps=60, inc=parsed.value/steps;
      var iv=setInterval(function(){
        cur+=inc;
        if(cur>=parsed.value){cur=parsed.value;clearInterval(iv);}
        heading.textContent=cur.toFixed(parsed.decimals)+parsed.suffix;
      },30);
    });
  },{threshold:.3});
  statCards.forEach(function(card){obs.observe(card);});
}
initStatCounters();

/* ── Nav scroll class ── */
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
var nav=document.getElementById('my-project-s-fixed-nav');
if(nav)nav.classList.toggle('my-project-s-scrolled',window.scrollY>60);
},{passive:true});

}());
</script>
<script>
(function(){
/* ── Source Script Bridge ── */
try{


    // Navbar scroll
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
      if (window.scrollY > 40) {
        nav.style.background = 'rgba(247,245,240,0.95)';
        nav.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
        nav.style.backdropFilter = 'blur(12px)';
      } else {
        nav.style.background = 'transparent';
        nav.style.boxShadow = 'none';
      }
    });

    // Hero entrance
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('hero-text')?.style.opacity = '1';
        document.getElementById('hero-text')?.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        document.getElementById('hero-visual')?.style.opacity = '1';
        document.getElementById('hero-visual')?.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
      }, 200);

      // Animate bars
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.bar').forEach(bar => {
          bar.style.height = bar.dataset.h + '%';
        });
      }, 700);

      // Count up stats
      setTimeout(() => animateCounter('stat-deals', 0, 47, 0), 1000);
      setTimeout(() => animateCounter('stat-rev', 0, 284, 1, '$', 'k'), 1000);
      setTimeout(() => animateCounter('stat-rate', 0, 68, 0, '', '%'), 1100);
    });

    function animateCounter(id, from, to, decimals, prefix = '', suffix = '') {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const duration = 1200;
      const start = performance.now();
      function step(now) {
        const t = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
        const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
        const val = from + (to - from) * ease;
        el.textContent = prefix + val.toFixed(decimals) + suffix;
        if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    // Pricing toggle
    function setPricing(mode) {
      const btnM = document.getElementById('my-project-s-pricing');
      const btnA = document.getElementById('btn-annual');
      document.querySelectorAll('.price').forEach(el => {
        el.textContent = el.dataset[mode];
      });
      if (mode === 'monthly') {
        btnM.style.cssText += 'background:#1A1A2E;color:#FFF;';
        btnA.style.cssText += 'background:transparent;color:#666;';
      } else {
        btnA.style.cssText += 'background:#1A1A2E;color:#FFF;';
        btnM.style.cssText += 'background:transparent;color:#666;';
      }
    }

    // Scroll reveal
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
          e.target.style.opacity = '1';
          e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    document.querySelectorAll('body.my-project-s-page #my-project-s-features, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bento-card, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bento-card-a, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bc-a, body.my-project-s-page #my-project-s-bento-card-a, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bento-card-b, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bc-b, body.my-project-s-page #my-project-s-bento-card-b, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bento-card-c, body.my-project-s-page .my-project-s-bc-c, body.my-project-s-page #my-project-s-bento-card-c').forEach(card => {
      card.style.opacity = '0';
      card.style.transform = 'translateY(24px)';
      card.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease';
      observer.observe(card);
    });
  
}catch(e){console.warn('my-project-s source script bridge failed',e);}
}());
</script>
